problem: The second-degree Taylor polynomial of a function $f(x)$ about $x=-1$ is given by ${P}_{2}(x)=4+3(x+1)+(x+1)^{2}.$ What is the value of ${f}^{′}(-1)?$
worked_solution:
This is an expansion about the point $x=-1,$ so the coefficient of the first-degree term is ${f}^{′}(-1).$ 

In the given equation, we see that the coefficient of the first-degree term is $3.$ So, we have

$$
{f}^{′}(-1)=3.
$$
